fusions.name: Venom Draught
fusions.desc: Spends 5% of your maximum health on a fang of venom that deals 9 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Patient Strike
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 20% health, a threshold that rises with each rank. A strike that deals 18 damage and uses up every affliction on the target, adding 1.4 times their remaining damage and 50% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Shed Skin
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you, and you regain 10 health.

fusions.name: Warm Side
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second.
